dedupe_keys.name: lignes et arrets du reseau de transport urbain tungt

description: Lignes et arrêts du réseau de transport urbain TUNGT is a dataset listed in Open Data CANGT, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CANGT. Ce jeu de données contient les fichiers GTFS décrivant le réseau de transport urbain TUNGT de la CANGT. Coverage: Grand Tarbes area (Hautes-Pyrénées). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Services, Social, Aménagement durable du territoire. Its keywords are Transport, Mobilité. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cangt-fr-portal.
